rows.en:
{C:8190B801}{C:81958296210000000000}Hey, hey, ladies!
I haven't seen your faces on this continent before.
Are you like me, by any chance?


{C:81930100}{C:819582968E2100000000}Like you...?
Did you come from another continent too?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968F2100000000}Big brother!!
You can't just blurt out
something like that!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296220000000000}Ahahaha...
You've got it rough, bro.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296902100000000}I sure do... Hey,
whose fault is that?!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296230000000000}Sorry, sorry.
I stopped you folks
because I wanted to ask a favor.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296912100000000}A favor from us?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296240000000000}That's right. I was wondering
if you'd let me aboard
your battleship.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296932100000000}Why should we let you
aboard our ship?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296250000000000}Whoa!
You're a feisty big sister, aren't you?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296942100000000}Who's your big sister?
I wouldn't want an obnoxious little brother
like you!

{C:81958296952100000000}Besides, no matter how you look at it,
you're older than I am!

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296260000000000}Then you'd better
listen to your elders, hadn't you?

{C:81958296270000000000}So, what do you say?
Will you let me aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296962100000000}What do we do, Rie?

{C:8190B801}{C:81958296280000000000}A battleship shaped just like yours
owes me one.

{C:81958296290000000000}Would you let me aboard
so I can get even?
I'll do anything!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296972100000000}In that case, I authorize you to come aboard.
I'm the captain, Rie Akatsuki.
It's nice to meet you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296982100000000}Hey, is that really all right?
You decided awfully quickly.
Don't you think so, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296992100000000}The captain's given permission,
so what's the problem?

{C:819582969A2100000000}I'm Nelfea Northrock,
a pilot.

{C:8190B801}{C:819582962A0000000000}Hehehehe!
I'm Sai Saici,
a Gundam Fighter.

{C:819582962B0000000000}Though I guess
that won't mean anything to you.
Anyway, nice to meet you!

{C:819582962C0000000000}You too, bro!

{C:81930100}{C:819582969B2100000000}Uh, yeah.
Nice to meet you.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296F42100000000}Thank you for trusting us.
Let me introduce myself again: Nie Given.
It's good to meet you.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F52100000000}I'm Rie Akatsuki,
captain of the Astante.

{C:81958296F72100000000}Thank you very much
for helping us earlier.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296F82100000000}I'm Marvel Frozen.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F92100000000}I'm the pilot,
Nelfea Northrock.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FA2100000000}Nice to meet you.

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296FB2100000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Chum Huau{C:819782830000}!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296FC2100000000}Whoa! What is this?!

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296FD2100000000}What do you mean, this?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296FE2100000000}Oh, you're so cute!

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296FF2100000000}See? That's the proper reaction!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296002200000000}Now, now, don't get so angry, Chum.
There probably aren't any Mi Ferario
on their continent.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296012200000000}I'm sorry.
You appeared so suddenly that I was surprised.
Will you forgive me?

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296022200000000}Oh, is that all?
Then I forgive you.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296032200000000}Um... Nie,
about what you wanted to discuss...

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296042200000000}I'll get straight to the point.
On this continent,
you're wanted fugitives.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296062200000000}Someone else
will explain the details to you.

{C:81958296082200000000}You've come from another continent.
Will you trust us
and come with us?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296092200000000}I'll go as our representative.
Rie, please wait on the Astante.

{C:81900400}{C:819582960A2200000000}That's right.
I'll go with him,
so you stay behind, Rie.

{C:81900300}{C:819582960B2200000000}Oh, Nelfea! That's not fair!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960C2200000000}I'd like you to stay behind too, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:819582960D2200000000}Why?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E2200000000}We can't leave the Astante unattended.
If those people from earlier came back,
there'd be nobody to defend it.

{C:819582960F2200000000}So I'm counting on you.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102200000000}All right.
Leave the Astante and Rie
to me.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296112200000000}Then shall we go,
Mr. Given and Ms. Frozen?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296322200000000}Oh, you can drop the formalities,

{C:81902600}{C:819582963C2200000000}Hahahahaha! Don't be like that!

{C:819582963D2200000000}Is that the one?

{C:81901E00}{C:819582963E2200000000}Yes.

{C:81902600}{C:819582963F2200000000}I see.
I'm Foizon Gow,
King of the Kingdom of Lau.

{C:81958296402200000000}Rest assured, you can leave
your ship in my care.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D32200000000}I'm sorry, Nie.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296D52200000000}We weren't strong enough.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E72200000000}Are you pursuing
the Norstan too?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582965D0000000000}You've come at just the right time.
Actually, this guy...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E82200000000}I'm sorry. I was watching.
The exchange of attacks and defenses was so amazing
that I missed my chance to step in.


{C:81901A00}{C:819582965F0000000000}Honestly, you...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E92200000000}I said I'm sorry!

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296600000000000}So, may I come aboard?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296EA2200000000}Well...
Let's leave that to the captain.
We should get Rie...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296EB2200000000}I already went and got her
while you were dawdling!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296EC2200000000}I'm the captain, Rie Akatsuki.
Are you the one
who wants to come aboard our ship?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296620000000000}Yes.
I learned of the disturbances in the world...
and came from another continent.

{C:81958296630000000000}If things continue like this,
the person I must protect
will be harmed too.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296ED2200000000}You have someone to protect?

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296640000000000}Yes.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296EE2200000000}In that case, I authorize you to come aboard.

{C:8190D001}{C:81958296650000000000}I see. Thank you.
I'm {C:819782830400}Trowa Barton.{C:819782830000}
I look forward to working with you.
